dct_description_sm: This project was developed to provide the necessary information to the communities to be able to develop adaptation strategies and to identify priority issues. This will allow North Shore Micmac District Council to create adaptation plans for the communities. The first phase of the study builds on previous work completed by 'Sea-level Rise Estimates for New Brunswick First Nations' done  in 2010 and the 'Assessment of Potential Impacts of Sea-level Rise and Climate Change on the Mi'gmaq of New Brunswick.' The adaptation strategies will then concentrate on erosion/flooding control, land use planning for impacted areas, and innovative building technologies.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Impacts of Climate Change on the Mi'gmaq of New Brunswick
